# Command-line reference

**For:** operators. Every command and option of the `ferrosmart` binary, as
`ferrosmart <command> --help` prints it. What each command is for is on
[operate and monitor](../operate/operations.md#the-commands).

## `ferrosmart`

```text
FerroSMART, the SMART App Launch authorization server

Usage: ferrosmart [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  serve        Serves until the process is asked to stop
  config       Works on the configuration
  healthcheck  Asks the server running beside this process whether it is ready, and exits 0 only when it is
  client       Works on the registered clients
  subject      Prints the FerroSMART `sub` of the person `--sub` names at the provider `--upstream` names, which a resource server binds them by
  upstream     Works on the upstream providers
  key          Works on key files
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --config <PATH>
          The TOML configuration file; unset, the product's `_CONFIG` variable names it

      --set <KEY=VALUE>
          One configuration key set over the file and the environment, as `key=value`; repeatable

  -h, --help
          Print help

  -V, --version
          Print version
```

## `ferrosmart config`

```text
Works on the configuration

Usage: ferrosmart config [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  check  Reads the configuration, reports every refusal with its key, and prints the running tree with every secret redacted
  help   Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:

          The TOML configuration file; unset, the product's `_CONFIG` variable names it
```

```text
  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `ferrosmart client`

```text
Works on the registered clients

Usage: ferrosmart client [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  apply   Writes each file's client document to the registry, creating the client or replacing the one with its `client_id`
  secret  Issues the confidential symmetric client `client_id` a new secret and prints it once (RFC 7591 §3.2.1)
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --config <PATH>
          The TOML configuration file; unset, the product's `_CONFIG` variable names it

      --set <KEY=VALUE>
          One configuration key set over the file and the environment, as `key=value`; repeatable

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `ferrosmart key generate`

```text
Writes a fresh ML-DSA private key as PKCS#8 PEM to a new file, readable by its owner alone

Usage: ferrosmart key generate [OPTIONS] --out <OUT>

Options:

          `ML-DSA-44`, `ML-DSA-65` or `ML-DSA-87`

      --config <PATH>

      --set <KEY=VALUE>
```
